bindingRow: The verdict `opensTheSameBlock` (src/line-verdict.ts) reads of the line the packer would write, held against the reading the reader RECORDED for the line that stood there: the site's own `OpeningReading` and, for a marker line, the style of the list on the block's reading. This type carried that pair as a DECLARED value built at one site only; the pair is now on the position, taken from facts the reader already put on the node, so nothing re-reads the source's bytes to rebuild it. NARROWER: the declared reading was only ever built as `text`, so the question was asked at the two unprefixed sites alone, and it is now asked at every site the packer writes a first line.

bindingRow: The twenty rows of tests/format/second-line-indent.test.ts, which are byte-red without the behaviour. The net traded the packer's space for the author's break and wrote the second line's own indent back in front of the stranded atom; the reader now refuses the whole LAYOUT whose first line reads as something else, and a refused layout writes every one of the block's own source lines back, indents and all. NARROWER on the print side and WIDER on the reading side, and the row records narrower: what comes back is more of the author's bytes, not fewer, but the trade is no longer available where the reader accepts the packed line (a role-prefixed opener whose whole line is prose now packs, where the net read the pair alone and refused).

bindingRow: The reader's own two questions about the lines the packer commits: `opensTheSameBlock` for the block's first output line and `accepts` for every line below it (src/line-verdict.ts), asked of the finished layout by `wrap` (src/print/reflow.ts). A layout holding a line the reader does not read as this block sends the whole block back to its own source lines. This predicate answered for a WORD instead, which is wider in every context but a list item's (a plain paragraph breaks on StartOfBlockProc alone, parser.rb l.36) and blind to a shape anchored at both ends. NARROWER: the word probe refused a join wherever the word could open a block anywhere; the reader refuses only where the line it would write reads as something else in the block's own context.
